versions.content: Optionality of timing constraints Type: valid Description: The usage of timing constraints in the AUTOSAR templates shall be optional. Rationale: Usually timing constraints are only specified for a limited number of e.g. safety-related sub-systems, but not for the complete system. Use Case: Analysis and validation of timing behavior Dependencies: None identified. Supporting Material: None
